//: Desktop scanner config. Relative dirs resolve against this file's location.
//data: Models and databases ship through Git LFS; run git lfs pull. See README.md for the assets/ layout.
//gameClassMapping: Model class id -> database name(s). MUST be contiguous from 0 and MUST match the class order the segmentation model was exported with; the entry count decodes the prediction tensor. Verified against CardSegmentationModel.onnx's `names` metadata. An array means the model merges games it cannot tell apart, and all of them get searched.
//confidenceThreshold: Reporting floor. Acceptance is the session's acceptScore (0.6); this lower value lets near-misses reach the diagnostics instead of vanishing.
//maxFrameRate: 0 disables core's throttle. The OBS filter's scan rate caps what arrives; a second cap on the same 33ms interval beat against it and returned dropped frames as empty scans.
//product: Where card names and art are looked up. productImageTransform is appended after the image path: ImageKit's URL transform, sized for the overlay.
